ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels to 20% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white region spanning the central area of both lobes. A thick, irregular black boundary exists along the entire trailing edge and lateral tips. Central axis features a vertical alignment of four distinct black horizontal markings. A singular, isolated black focal spot is located in the mid-upper quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45-50 degrees and moderate penetration depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across both lobes, characterized by frequent peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe sweep exhibits a moderate convexity as it moves from the central notch towards the lateral tips, with the left lobe showing a slightly sharper upward curvature than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple low-contrast circular depressions and shadows (pitting) are visible across the white field of the left lobe. A high-contrast black circular spot is fixed on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The far-right lateral tip shows significant irregular thickening and dark, textured accumulation, consistent with previous heavy barnacle colonization or localized trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'segmented' vertical black pigment pattern along the central midline, appearing as four separate horizontal dash marks.
